# engine_platform: src/engine/platform/ and win32/ (tools/engine_layout.py).
# Generated by tools/move_engine_files.py; edited by hand from here on.

add_library(engine_platform STATIC)

file(GLOB ENGINE_PLATFORM_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.cc"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/win32/*.cc"
)
list(FILTER ENGINE_PLATFORM_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "_test(_util)?\\.cc$")

file(GLOB ENGINE_PLATFORM_HEADERS CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.h"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/win32/*.h"
)

target_sources(engine_platform PRIVATE
        ${ENGINE_PLATFORM_SOURCES}
)

target_sources(engine_platform PUBLIC
        FILE_SET HEADERS
        BASE_DIRS ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src
        FILES ${ENGINE_PLATFORM_HEADERS}
)

find_package(SDL2 REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(engine_platform
        PUBLIC engine_base absl::core_headers
        PRIVATE SDL2::SDL2 absl::check absl::strings
)

# Tests
include(Testing)
add_gtest(
        NAME engine_platform_test
        SOURCES env_test.cc file_system_test.cc ftimer_test.cc random_seed_test.cc sleep_test.cc
            win32/win32_com_test.cc win32/win32_system_test.cc
        LIBS engine_platform tech
)
